title: bluebird — proprietorship

sentences.sentence: A bluebird in the garden, a spirit in a house, a kind man on the side of the road.
sentences.translation: 花园中的蓝知更鸟，房屋中的精灵，路边的好人。

sentences.sentence: It sounds like the singing of lark birds.
sentences.translation: 这歌声就像百灵鸟一样清脆。

sentences.sentence: Only the little lark never sang.
sentences.translation: 不过这只百灵鸟从来不歌唱。

sentences.sentence: Two women in widow's black touch his arm sociably as he passes the street corner where they sit singing folk songs to each other.
sentences.translation: 两个身着素黑衣服的女人坐在街角互相唱着民谣，当他从身边走过时她们和蔼地轻拍他的手臂。

sentences.sentence: She watched the parade from her perch on her father’s shoulders.
sentences.translation: 她骑在父亲的肩上观看游行。

sentences.sentence: A geometrical wonder, DOME ECILE not only is a sight in and of itself, but it also sports beautiful beach views.
sentences.translation: 这是一个几何学上的奇迹，DOME ECILE本身就是一处景观，但从这里你还可以看到漂亮的沙滩。

translations.translation: 醒,唤醒 a警觉的, 醒的

sentences.sentence: It was midday when she awoke.
sentences.translation: 她醒来时已是中午。

sentences.sentence: We awoke to a day of brilliant sunshine.
sentences.translation: 我们醒来时阳光明媚。

sentences.sentence: Many kinds of woodland can be seen on the various walks which radiate from the Heritage Centre.
sentences.translation: 从遗产中心向外伸展的各条走道上可以看到多种林地。

sentences.sentence: obsolete weapons
sentences.translation: 已被淘汰的武器

sentences.sentence: computer hardware that quickly became obsolete
sentences.translation: 很快就变得过时的电脑硬件

sentences.sentence: Will computers render (= make ) books obsolete?
sentences.translation: 计算机会把书籍淘汰掉吗？

sentences.sentence: The insertion of an inner rod into the waveguide can rarefy the spectrum of the competing modes in the vicinity of the operating mode and restrict the mode competing effectively.
sentences.translation: 在圆柱腔体内插入一个内导体将会使工作模式附近的模谱变稀，从而有效的抑制模式竞争。

translations.translation: 装饰船头的雕像, 破浪神

sentences.sentence: I propose that every time an American bags a snipe, the federal government should pay him or her $100.
sentences.translation: 美国需要更多的猎鹬者，我提议一个美国人每捕到一只鹬，联邦政府支付给他100美元。

sentences.sentence: In areas where river deltas inject organic material and dissolved trace elements into the sea, for instance, it’s not clear how all of the intricately related processes will affect water chemistry.
sentences.translation: 例如，在有些地区，河流三角洲将有机物质和溶解的微量元素注入海洋，目前还不清楚所有这些错综复杂的相关进程将如何影响水的化学性能。

sentences.sentence: To open a new file, click on the icon.
sentences.translation: 要打开新文档，点击该图标。

sentences.sentence: The hunter disembowelled the antelope.
sentences.translation: 猎人取出羚羊的内脏。

sentences.sentence: Hello little antelope, would you like to play with us?
sentences.translation: 你好，小羚羊，愿意跟我们一起玩吗？

sentences.sentence: "The marks on the inside of one antelope jaw showed they cut out the tongue, " White said.
sentences.translation: “一块羚羊颌骨内部的痕迹表明，这些原始人曾将它的舌头割了去，”怀特说。

sentences.sentence: One possibility, according to Hogan, would be to use a device called an atom interferometer.
sentences.translation: 霍根说，一种可行方式是使用所谓的“原子干涉仪”设备。

sentences.sentence: This is achieved by firing a laser down a 600 meter long tube where it is split, reflected and directed into an interferometer.
sentences.translation: 实现这一功能，需要发射一束激光，穿过600米的隧道后，将激光分裂成两束，经过反射的一束和未反射的一束均进入干涉仪。

sentences.sentence: Currently under construction in Fermilab, the Holometer (meaning holographic interferometer) will delve deep into this quantum realm at smaller scales than the GEO600 experiment.
sentences.translation: 目前在费米实验室制造的“全息干涉仪”，将比GEO600探测到更小的尺度，进入到量子尺度。

translations.translation: 努力工作的,  勤奋的

sentences.sentence: He was hardworking and energetic.
sentences.translation: 他很努力且精力充沛。

sentences.sentence: She would preside over the innocent repasts of the young heir, with ineffable satisfaction, almost with an air of joint proprietorship with Richards in the entertainment.
sentences.translation: 她会怀着难以形容的满意心情主持这位年轻继承人的天真的用餐，那副神态就几乎像在这个款待中她跟理查兹共同享有所有权似的。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 440 单元

bluebird
音标：英 /'bluːbɜːd/  美 /'blubɝd/
n. 北美产的蓝知更鸟
例句：A bluebird in the garden, a spirit in a house, a kind man on the side of the road.
花园中的蓝知更鸟，房屋中的精灵，路边的好人。

lark
音标：英 /lɑːk/  美 /lɑrk/
n. 云雀, 百灵鸟
短语：for a lark — 当作玩笑；为了取乐
短语：rise with the lark — 早起
例句：It sounds like the singing of lark birds.
这歌声就像百灵鸟一样清脆。
例句：Only the little lark never sang.
不过这只百灵鸟从来不歌唱。

communally
adv. 共同地, 社区地

rooster
音标：英 /'ruːstə/  美 /'rustɚ/
n. 雄禽,

sociably
adv. 和蔼可亲地
例句：Two women in widow's black touch his arm sociably as he passes the street corner where they sit singing folk songs to each other.
两个身着素黑衣服的女人坐在街角互相唱着民谣，当他从身边走过时她们和蔼地轻拍他的手臂。

perch
音标：英 /pɜːtʃ/  美 /pɝtʃ/
n. 栖息处 v暂栖，停留
例句：She watched the parade from her perch on her father’s shoulders.
她骑在父亲的肩上观看游行。

geometrical
音标：英 /dʒɪə'metrɪkl/  美 /dʒɪə'mɛtrɪkl/
adj. 几何学的,  几何的
短语：geometrical model — 几何模型
短语：geometrical optics — 几何光学
短语：geometrical relationship — 几何关系
短语：geometrical characteristic — 几何特性
短语：geometrical condition — 几何条件
例句：A geometrical wonder, DOME ECILE not only is a sight in and of itself, but it also sports beautiful beach views.
这是一个几何学上的奇迹，DOME ECILE本身就是一处景观，但从这里你还可以看到漂亮的沙滩。

awake
音标：英 /ə'weɪk/  美 /ə'wek/
v. 醒,唤醒 a警觉的, 醒的
短语：stay awake — 保持清醒；保持醒着的
短语：wide awake — 清醒的；机警的
短语：awake from — 从…中醒来，察觉
例句：It was midday when she awoke.
她醒来时已是中午。
例句：We awoke to a day of brilliant sunshine.
我们醒来时阳光明媚。

radiate
音标：英 /'reɪdɪeɪt/  美 /'redɪet/
v. 放射, 辐射
短语：radiate from — 从……发出
例句：Many kinds of woodland can be seen on the various walks which radiate from the Heritage Centre.
从遗产中心向外伸展的各条走道上可以看到多种林地。

obsolete
音标：英 /'ɒbsəliːt/  美 /ɑbsəˌlit/
adj. 已废弃的, 过时的
短语：obsolete equipment — 陈旧设备
例句：obsolete weapons
已被淘汰的武器
例句：computer hardware that quickly became obsolete
很快就变得过时的电脑硬件
例句：Will computers render (= make ) books obsolete?
计算机会把书籍淘汰掉吗？

rarefy
音标：英 /'reərɪfaɪ/  美 /'rɛrə,fai/
v. 稀薄
例句：The insertion of an inner rod into the waveguide can rarefy the spectrum of the competing modes in the vicinity of the operating mode and restrict the mode competing effectively.
在圆柱腔体内插入一个内导体将会使工作模式附近的模谱变稀，从而有效的抑制模式竞争。

crossbones
音标：英 /'krɒsbəʊnz/  美 /'krɔsbonz/
n. 交叉腿骨的图形

figurehead
音标：英 /'fɪgəhed/  美 /'fɪgjɚ'hɛd/
n. 装饰船头的雕像, 破浪神

snipe
音标：英 /snaɪp/  美 /snaɪp/
n. [鸟]鹬
例句：I propose that every time an American bags a snipe, the federal government should pay him or her $100.
美国需要更多的猎鹬者，我提议一个美国人每捕到一只鹬，联邦政府支付给他100美元。

intricately
音标：英 /'ɪntrɪkətlɪ/  美 /ˈɪntrəkɪtlɪ/
adv. 杂乱地,  复杂地
例句：In areas where river deltas inject organic material and dissolved trace elements into the sea, for instance, it’s not clear how all of the intricately related processes will affect water chemistry.
例如，在有些地区，河流三角洲将有机物质和溶解的微量元素注入海洋，目前还不清楚所有这些错综复杂的相关进程将如何影响水的化学性能。

icon
音标：英 /'aɪkɒn; -k(ə)n/  美 /'aɪkɑn/
n. 图标, 肖像
短语：cultural icon — 文化偶像
短语：application icon — n. 应用程序图标
例句：To open a new file, click on the icon.
要打开新文档，点击该图标。

antelope
音标：英 /'æntɪləʊp/  美 /'æntɪlop/
n. 羚羊
短语：tibetan antelope — 藏羚羊
例句：The hunter disembowelled the antelope.
猎人取出羚羊的内脏。
例句：Hello little antelope, would you like to play with us?
你好，小羚羊，愿意跟我们一起玩吗？
例句："The marks on the inside of one antelope jaw showed they cut out the tongue, " White said.
“一块羚羊颌骨内部的痕迹表明，这些原始人曾将它的舌头割了去，”怀特说。

interferometer
音标：英 /,ɪntəfə'rɒmɪtə/  美 /,ɪntɚfɪ'rɑmətɚ/
n. 干涉计
短语：laser interferometer — 激光干涉仪
短语：michelson interferometer — 迈克耳孙干涉仪
例句：One possibility, according to Hogan, would be to use a device called an atom interferometer.
霍根说，一种可行方式是使用所谓的“原子干涉仪”设备。
例句：This is achieved by firing a laser down a 600 meter long tube where it is split, reflected and directed into an interferometer.
实现这一功能，需要发射一束激光，穿过600米的隧道后，将激光分裂成两束，经过反射的一束和未反射的一束均进入干涉仪。
例句：Currently under construction in Fermilab, the Holometer (meaning holographic interferometer) will delve deep into this quantum realm at smaller scales than the GEO600 experiment.
目前在费米实验室制造的“全息干涉仪”，将比GEO600探测到更小的尺度，进入到量子尺度。

hardworking
音标：英 /'hɑːd,wɜːkɪŋ/  美 /'hɑrd,wɝkɪŋ/
adj. 努力工作的,  勤奋的
例句：He was hardworking and energetic.
他很努力且精力充沛。

proprietorship
音标：英 /prə'praiətə,ʃip/  美 /prə'praɪətɚ,ʃɪp/
n. 所有权
短语：sole proprietorship — 独资（经营）
短语：individual proprietorship — 独资企业；独资经营
例句：She would preside over the innocent repasts of the young heir, with ineffable satisfaction, almost with an air of joint proprietorship with Richards in the entertainment.
她会怀着难以形容的满意心情主持这位年轻继承人的天真的用餐，那副神态就几乎像在这个款待中她跟理查兹共同享有所有权似的。
